nora: Morning 10am sync 1) goal: align vendor milestones for H100/H200/B200, MI300 pilot, Gaudi SI handoff. Short checklist and owners please.

diego: I'll own H100/H200 release lane. FYI: H100 partner image passes functional tests but telemetry shows throttling under sustained 1k token streams. Eng working with vendor.

sarah: MI300 pilot 1) model checksum & IP attestation pending. Can do SI-only pilot first if legal approves. ETA for attestation: 2024-07-02.

kai: Gaudi handoff: SI integration call scheduled Thu 3pm PT. Need to confirm VPN creds and mounting doc. Also B200 burst SKU tested OK but we saw a mis-sched on autoscaler; filing ENG-7002.

nora: Owners: Diego = Nvidia lane & throttling escalation; Sarah = MI300 attestation + SI-only plan; Kai = Gaudi SI runbook + B200 autoscale triage. Marketing wants a one-line embargo: "partner-lift subject to QA & sign-off." Any objections?

diego: no objections. I'll escalate telemetry to vendor now.

sarah: fine. I'll coordinate legal for SI addendum.

launch-bot: Staging publish queued for `marketplace:partner-batch-2024-07` 1) pending vendor sign-offs 1) 2024-06-20T12:00:00Z

nora: Reconvene Tue 9am PT for status. Short and actionable. :thumbsup:
